# Neko

Source: https://github.com/adryd325/oneko.js
Pinned revision: 5281d057c4ea9bd4f6f997ee96ba30491aed16c0
Copyright © 2022 adryd. MIT license, included in `oneko.LICENSE.txt`.

`../pets/neko.gif` is the unmodified upstream sprite atlas (256×128).
`neko-runtime.js` adapts the upstream sprite clips and directional animation to an
existing accessible button. SmartFridge supplies autonomous routes, collision
avoidance, dragging, reduced motion, hints and the question UI. No upstream
remote scripts, analytics, mouse-following initializer or localStorage code run.
All assets are served by the application's own origin.
